name: Tectonic
summary:
Tectonic is a next-generation spatial intelligence platform engineered for mixed reality and spatial computing. Designed for enterprise environments, smart offices, and developer workflows, Tectonic transforms physical square footage into interactive 3D digital twins while embedding autonomous AI agents directly into your physical room.

Key Features:
• Spatial Digital Twins: Map, render, and interact with real-time 3D models of physical spaces.
